message.content:
Use the sum identity
\[
\sin 2\theta+\sin 4\theta+\cdots+\sin 14\theta
=\frac{\sin 7\theta \sin 8\theta}{\sin \theta}.
\]
Thus
\[
2\sin\theta(\sin2\theta+\cdots+\sin14\theta)
=2\sin7\theta\sin8\theta.
\]
Using \(2\sin A\sin B=\cos(A-B)-\cos(A+B)\),
\[
2\sin7\theta\sin8\theta=\cos\theta-\cos15\theta.
\]
So the equation becomes
\[
\cos\theta-\cos15\theta=\cos\theta-\frac12,
\]
which simplifies to
\[
\cos15\theta=\frac12.
\]

Since \(0^\circ\le \theta\le 24^\circ\), we have
\[
0^\circ\le 15\theta\le 360^\circ.
\]
So
\[
15\theta=60^\circ \quad \text{or} \quad 15\theta=300^\circ.
\]
Therefore
\[
\theta=4^\circ \quad \text{or} \quad \theta=20^\circ.
\]

The answer is \(4^\circ, 20^\circ\).
